optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Delivery Project Coordinator, Customer Ticketing System
professionalSummary: Experienced delivery coordinator with a proven track record of managing end-to-end implementation projects for six enterprise customers, ensuring timely delivery, risk mitigation, and successful go‑live sign‑offs.
experienceHighlights: Maintained comprehensive implementation plans, action logs, and consultant schedules in the project tool, keeping the customer‑facing status page current each week.
Prepared and hosted weekly customer status calls, recording decisions and actions, and ensuring clear communication of scope and commercial matters.
Escalated schedule and resourcing risks to the delivery manager with recommended options, while maintaining clear responsibility boundaries.
Drafted detailed close‑out reports from action logs and call minutes, documenting limitations and hand‑over items for customer support.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Action log export and close‑out report for one implementation, including project tool record identifiers as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample confirm the candidate’s experience in plan maintenance, status calls, risk escalation, and close‑out reporting, but do not explicitly confirm that she alone held the go‑live sign‑off or managed consultant assignments without delivery manager involvement.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to confirm go‑live sign‑off ownership and consultant assignment responsibility.

role.roleTitle: Delivery Project Coordinator, Customer Ticketing System

evidence.text: Maintained the implementation plan, action log and consultant schedule for six enterprise implementations in the project tool, keeping the customer-facing status page current each week.
evidence.notes: Shows project ownership but not explicit go-live sign-off

evidence.text: Escalated schedule and resourcing risks to the delivery manager with an option each; consultant assignments were decided by the delivery manager, and customer go-live was signed off by the customer's project sponsor with the delivery manager.
evidence.notes: Indicates go-live sign-off involved delivery manager

evidence.text: Candidate said she 'ran the implementations end-to-end' and that the delivery manager was mostly there for the commercials; asked who signed go-live, she said the sponsor and the delivery manager did.

evidence.text: Maintained the implementation plan, action log and consultant schedule for six enterprise implementations in the project tool, keeping the customer-facing status page current each week.
Prepared and hosted the weekly customer status call for my assigned implementations, recording decisions and actions; scope and commercial questions on the call were answered by the delivery manager.

Escalated schedule and resourcing risks to the delivery manager with an option each; consultant assignments were decided by the delivery manager, and customer go-live was signed off by the customer's project sponsor with the delivery manager.
Drafted the close-out report for each implementation from the action log and the call minutes, listing open limitations and the hand-over items for customer support.
